detached_structure.evidence: A greenish roof near the top center, partly hidden by trees, and a small gray-roofed structure near center suggest outbuildings or parts of the house, but their identity is unclear.

signals.notes: The central lot is almost entirely hidden under dense mature tree canopy, so the house, yard and driveway cannot be assessed from above. The large brown-roofed house at the right edge belongs to a neighboring lot.
